|game_text=May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you here.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip that prints it. The current text is [[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. The PC card image ([[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]], PC-E2) and the Master List both print this text again word for word.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you here.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 117. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-117-Tydirium.png]]) prints slip number “117” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) dropped “here” from the last sentence: “May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you.”.<ref name="cl-1230_114-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-tydirium-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual3-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/tydirium.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual3-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock3-Light/large/tydirium.gif</ref>: “May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you here.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 3 set mark) and prints the number “117” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Tydirium (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 51), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=51, page 51. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=51 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you here.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1230-114-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
